summary: P1.4c main-body in-process re-point — close CG-4 for the SECOND in-process submit entry. Per section C.7 and the controller-verified P0.0 oracle, the main-body Alembic lib/governance/gateway/GatewayActionRegistry.ts has two actions, candidate:create (around lines 24-29) and recipe:create (around lines 77-82), that both call knowledgeService.create(ctx.data) DIRECTLY — they do NOT route through the AlembicAgent handleSubmit that P1.4b just re-pointed, and they run only Core stage-3 (no stage-1/2). Re-point them: before knowledgeService.create, run the canonical authoring gate validateAgainst([item], {stage:'all', path:'in-process', profile: resolveAuthoringProfile(context), sourceRefResolver: an in-process fs resolver, dimensionId}) from @alembic/core/knowledge, and on violations reject with the existing main-body error shape. Profile semantics identical to P1.4b: runtime in-process AI without a cold-start session resolves to OPPORTUNISTIC (all content gates plus cheap grounding, NOT the 3-distinct-files floor, NOT session-scope); dimension-bearing bootstrap resolves to cold-start (full gate). REUSE if possible: if the main-body can import the AlembicAgent in-process gate (runInProcessRecipeAuthoringGate from @alembic/agent, since the main-body embeds the agent runtime), reuse it to avoid a third fs-resolver copy; otherwise supply the in-process gate plus a byte-faithful fs sourceRefResolver per the section C.11 port pattern (the same one AlembicAgent shipped). If the main-body has its OWN AI producer prompt that authors these recipes (distinct from the AlembicAgent insightProducer that P1.4b already upgraded), upgrade it producer-first via renderGuidance('in-process', profile) BEFORE enabling the gate, per the C.4 discipline; if the main-body recipes come from the embedded AlembicAgent producer, that is already covered and you only do the gate re-point. Acceptance on node 22: main-body build:check green; a re-point test proving both GatewayActionRegistry create actions now run validateAgainst before knowledgeService.create (content gates fire, opportunistic drops floor and session-scope); a currently-passing-corpus regression documenting the bounded new-reject set; if you added a producer prompt, a producer-renders-from-module test; full main-body test green. Discipline: this is the same SCOPED in-process tightening as P1.4b (opportunistic lighter bar, not a relaxation; cold-start full gate matches the host); gate output bytes unchanged; main only, no push or tag or version bump; do NOT touch AlembicCore, AlembicPlugin, AlembicAgent, FieldSpec, or the dead recipe-evidence-gate duplicate. Producer-consumer: you consume the shipped Core profile model and (optionally) the AlembicAgent in-process gate; this is the last in-process entry, completing CG-4 across all submission paths. Backfill the main-body commit, the re-point diff, the currently-passing-corpus new-reject set, whether you reused the AlembicAgent gate or supplied your own resolver, and raw build and test output. If the tightening would reject a recipe you believe should pass, STOP and return needs-review with the case.
sourceRef: Design/docs/current/alembic-recipe-authoring-guidance-optimization-2026-06-29.md sections C.7 (second in-process entry), B-P1.4, 12.4 plus state-root evidence/p0-gate-truth-matrix-2026-06-30.md (the main-body GatewayActionRegistry entry) plus the accepted AlembicAgent in-process gate (eab6c88, runInProcessRecipeAuthoringGate) and the Core profile model (8771524, @alembic/core/knowledge)
